newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-CHAMPIONS SPARTAK KEEP TOP SPOT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHAMPIONS SPARTAK KEEP TOP SPOT.

text.p: Defending champions Spartak Moscow maintained their slight lead in the Russian league over Rotor Volgograd after a 1-0 away victory over Fakel Voronezh on Wednesday.

Rotor, who trail Spartak by one point after 14 games, kept pace with the leaders after a 3-1 home win over Zhemchuzhina Sochi, while Dynamo Moscow lost valuable points when they were held to a 1-1 draw by city rivals Torpedo LM.
Maxim Buznikin's 65th minute strike enabled Spartak to take the maximum three points from last place Fakel.

Dynamo, on the other hand, wasted numerous chances in the first half and had only a slim 1-0 advantage thanks to a 26th minute goal by Alexander Kulchiy. Brazilian forward Carlos Alberto equalised for Torpedo in the second half.
Lokomotiv Moscow found a scoring touch after their Russian Cup win a week ago and comfortably beat KamAZ Naberezhnye Chelny 2-0 with two goals from Alexei Kosolapov.
Last year's runner-up Alania Vladikavkaz got back into the title chase with a 5-2 home trashing of Shinnik Yaroslavl. The victory followed a series of poor showings by the North Ossetian team.
